definitions.explanation: The original sum of money invested or lent, as distinct from any interest or profit earned on it.

examples.japanese: {元金|がんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{元金|がんきん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{減|へ}らして→減らす：02414_herasu⟧いか⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: You need to reduce not just the interest but also the principal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{元金|がんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took three years to recoup the original investment.

notes:
Composed of {元|がん} (original, base) + {金|きん} (money). A fundamental financial term. Can also be read もときん, though がんきん is more standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {元金|がんきん}⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧ (principal repayment)
- {元金|がんきん}{均等|きんとう}⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧ (equal principal repayment)
- {元金|がんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧ (recoup the principal)
- {元金|がんきん}⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧ (principal guarantee)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {元手|もとで} — capital, seed money (more colloquial, often for starting a business)
- ⟦{資本|しほん}→資本：03197_shihon⟧ — capital (broader economic term)
- ⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧ — interest (the return on the principal, the counterpart concept)
- ⟦{元本|がんぽん}→元本：07072_ganpon⟧ — principal (close synonym, slightly more formal/legal)
